content:
Maria: quick handoff — passing nightwatch to @Sam for the 02:00 UTC deployment of payment-service v3.5. Freeze window 01:30-03:30 UTC. There's a small DB backfill during the rollout; expected low-to-medium risk. Notes below.

Sam: taking it. quick Qs: major risks? rollback steps?

Maria: main risks: cache warm-up causing short p95 spikes, backfill adds DB write load for ~15-30m, and a flaky third-party auth call that sometimes times out. Rollback: revert to v3.4 tag and scale down new workers. Alert/playbook is in #incidents for auth spikes.

Jia: I'll be secondary watcher for first 30m after canary. I'll monitor latency and error rates. Ping me if p95 > 220ms or 5xx > 0.8%.

Sam: noted. who is watching the canary rollout? I can be primary watcher and escalate if needed.

Maria: @Sam primary, @Jia secondary. ops-automation will kick the scheduled rollout; deploy-bot will post status. I pasted the commands below.

Maria: commands (for reference):
```
# start canary
opsctl deploy payment-service --image=payment:v3.5 --strategy=canary --canary-percent=10
# rollback
opsctl rollback payment-service --to-tag=v3.4
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: payment-service v3.5 at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z (freeze 01:30-03:30). Notifying watchers: @Sam @Jia

Sam: thanks bot :thumbsup: i'll be at my desk. is the backfill an online migration or a separate job?

Maria: separate one-off k8s job, concurrency limited to 4. Expected <30m. Logs to /var/log/backfills/payment-v3.5.log.

Jia: healthcheck thresholds I'll watch:
```
- p95 > 220ms -> pause canary
- 5xx > 0.8% (5m window) -> pause canary + alert
- auth timeouts > 10/min -> investigate third-party auth
```

Sam: adding a quick smoke after canary: POST /payments/test-charge with feature_flag=canary.

Maria: FYI client SDKs do graceful fallback; last time we saw a small surge to fallback during cache warm-up. If sustained 10-20% fallback traffic, consider running opsctl run cache-primer.

Sam: I'll start canary at 02:00 and post updates here. handing-off complete — i'm oncall now :white_check_mark: 

Jia: monitoring dashboards, will DM if thresholds trip.

Maria: handoff notes saved: https://redwood.internal/handoffs/1802004567

Sam: acknowledged. will escalate to @eng-sre if anything odd. good handoff :rocket: 

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for payment-service v3.5 — 10% traffic routed. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/payment-service/1802004567

Sam: saw it. watching p50/p95/errors. will post status at +10m.

Jia: +1 monitoring. good luck :eyes: 

Sam: 02:10 UTC update — canary healthy, p95 128ms, 5xx 0.02%. promoting to 50% now.

deploy-bot: Promotion executed — canary -> 50% at 2026-03-18T02:10:00Z

Sam: keeping eyes until 03:00 then hand back to routine oncall. handing-off ETA ~03:05 if stable.

Maria: thanks for covering and smooth swap.

Sam: handing back to @Maria at 03:06 UTC — final: release stable, backfill finished, no rollback. closing handoff thread :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Deployment completed: payment-service v3.5 at 2026-03-18T03:06:12Z. Backfill job succeeded. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/payment-service/1802004567/final
